mcq_fix.s: The constitutional provisions relating to the Six-Point Formula and the Central University in Andhra Pradesh (Articles 371D and 371E) were inserted by which amendment?
mcq_fix.why: drop meta phrase 'as identified in the AP-specific reference'

mcq_drop.why: opinion item ('most controversial in cited debates')

pyq_bad.why: wrong options: codes reduced to single numerals, match unanswerable
wrong topic: current affairs (Har Ghar Tiranga)

patterns: Mostly 'which amendment did X' one-liners: Right to Property removed (44th), voting age 18 (61st), anti-defection (52nd), NCT Delhi (69th), 21A (86th), Ninth Schedule (1st).
APPSC uses A-R on the 42nd 'Mini-Constitution' (Preamble, Seventh Schedule, 54 articles) and 'which amendment' on 21A.
Recurring traps: 42nd vs 44th (who made advice binding vs who allowed one return), 73rd vs 74th schedules, 53rd/55th/56th statehood numbers.
App leans heavily on long match/statement items with article numbers and enforcement dates; PYQs are shorter and simpler.
AP angle (32nd Amendment, 371D/371E) is in the app but not yet seen in PYQs here.
